story: An icon of the skies, the Egyptian Vulture (Neophron percnopterus) is a species from the Accipitridae family. It thrives in Semi-arid/arid regions; open landscapes; cliffs; mountainous areas; steppes; savannahs; and plains, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Endangered (EN), the Egyptian Vulture is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Egyptian Vulture helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Egyptian Vulture, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
